prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one independent full-bleed event illustration for a nautical adventure game. Landscape 4:3 composition. Detailed hand-painted painterly realism, confident brushwork, believable weathered wood, bronze, rope, water and cloth. Strong clear main subject readable at 256px thumbnail, rich depth, natural anatomy. Tropical reef sea with bright turquoise blue-green water, dark rocky islets, warm wooden sailing craft, deep blue sky and sunlit clouds unless scene specifies night. Preindustrial age of sail. No text, lettering, logos, UI, title, border, collage, panels, watermark, or modern technology. Make one scene only. Subtle stars and faint moon glow; a small warm ship lantern provides contrast. The glowing underwater topography is the main subject, natural marine bioluminescence, no magical runes or invented creatures.
